definitions.gloss: part of speech; word class; grammatical category
definitions.explanation: A grammatical classification of words based on their function in a sentence, such as noun, verb, adjective, adverb, and so on. A fundamental concept in Japanese grammar study.

examples.japanese: この{単語|たんご}の{品詞|ひんし}は{何|なん}ですか。
examples.english: What part of speech is this word?

examples.japanese: {日本語|にほんご}には{多|おお}くの{品詞|ひんし}がある。
examples.english: Japanese has many parts of speech.

examples.japanese: {辞書|じしょ}で{単語|たんご}を{調|しら}べるとき、{品詞|ひんし}を{確認|かくにん}すると{使|つか}い{方|かた}がわかりやすい。
examples.english: When looking up a word in the dictionary, checking its part of speech makes it easier to understand how to use it.

notes:
USAGE:
A grammar term used in language study and linguistics. Japanese traditional grammar recognizes categories such as {名詞|めいし} (noun), {動詞|どうし} (verb), {形容詞|けいようし} (adjective), {副詞|ふくし} (adverb), {助詞|じょし} (particle), and {助動詞|じょどうし} (auxiliary verb), among others.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {品詞|ひんし}を{調|しら}べる (to look up the part of speech)
- {品詞|ひんし}{分類|ぶんるい} (classification by part of speech)
- {品詞|ひんし}{分解|ぶんかい} (parsing into parts of speech)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {文法|ぶんぽう}: grammar — the broader system of language rules
- {語類|ごるい}: word class — a more academic synonym
